title_en: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only
title_zh: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B：仅用强化学习训练的 27B 智能体编程模型
summary_en: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, its first open-weight agentic coding model post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B using reinforcement learning only, with no SFT or distillation. Training used about 1,200 curated tasks on 144 H200 GPUs for 18 days via the Miles RL framework, achieving 37% MFU and a 2.0x end-to-end speedup. Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 more than doubled from 5.6 to 12.0, with smaller gains on DeepSWE v1.1 (+4.0), SWE Bench Pro v2 (+3.4), and IFBench (82.4). The 27.8B dense model supports 262,144-token context and runs on a single GPU (52 GB BF16, 23 GB NVFP4), released under Apache 2.0.
summary_zh: RadixArk 发布了其首个开放权重模型 DaisyRose-27B，这是一个基于 Qwen3.8-27B 仅通过强化学习（RL）后训练的智能体编程模型，未使用 SFT 或蒸馏。训练使用约 1,200 个精选任务，在 144 块 H200 GPU 上通过 Miles RL 框架运行 18 天，达到 37% MFU 和 2.0 倍端到端加速。Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 从 5.6 翻倍至 12.0，DeepSWE v1.1 提升 4.0，SWE Bench Pro v2 提升 3.4，IFBench 达 82.4。该 27.8B 稠密模型支持 262,144 token 上下文，单 GPU 可运行（BF16 约 52 GB，NVFP4 约 23 GB），以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。
content_en:
This week RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, its first open-weight model. DaisyRose-27B is an agentic coding model from RadixArk, post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning (RL). The model card page states that it used RL only, with no SFT or distillation. It ships under Apache 2.0 as a drop-in replacement for the base model. The main result: Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 rises from 5.6 to 12.0. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** 27.8B dense parameters (0.46B vision encoder, 0.42B MTP head), 262,144-token context.
- **Runs on:** 1 GPU. BF16 is about 52 GB, FP8 about 29 GB, NVFP4 about 23 GB (Blackwell only). Listed targets: H200, B200, GB300, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, DGX Spark. GGUF also available.
- **Performance:** Beats its Qwen3.8-27B base on all 7 reported benchmarks.
- **Best:** IFBench 82.4, the top score among the 9 models RadixArk compared.
- **Worst:** HLE (text only) 34.3, only +0.4 over the base and below Inkling 2 Small’s 44.1.
- **Bottom line:** Best: Terminal Bench 4.1 more than doubles after 18 days of RL. Worst: it still trails much larger MoE models on hard agentic tasks.

## **What is DaisyRose-27B?**

DaisyRose-27B keeps the Qwen3.8-27B architecture unchanged. The model card lists 64 decoder layers in a 3:1 pattern. Three Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers alternate with 1 full-attention layer. Hidden size is 5,120. A 27-layer vision encoder handles images. One multi-token-prediction layer supports speculative decoding. Input is text and images, output is text, and it is a thinking model.

## **How was DaisyRose-27B trained?**

RadixArk built about 1,200 curated tasks with Eigent AI, chosen from thousands of candidates. Each task targets a specific failure of the base model. Each sandbox attempt allows up to 1.5 hours, 100+ tool calls and 256k+ output tokens. Agent sessions reach up to 1M tokens, per the blog.

Training ran on Miles, RadixArk’s open-source RL framework, in fully asynchronous mode. The run used 144 H200 GPUs for 18 days. Of those, 128 handled agent inference and 16 handled training. Total compute was 63,000 GPU-hours.

RadixArk reports 37% MFU on its internal backend. An open-source Megatron-based trainer reached 16%. End-to-end throughput was 16.8k tokens/s versus 8.3k, a 2.0x speedup. RadixArk says this cut GPU time by 57%.

Sandboxes ran on AgentENV. RadixArk reports about 944,000 sandboxes from mid-September to mid-November. Peak concurrency hit 1,566. Creation success was 99% over 9 weeks. RadixArk puts the cost about 80% below popular cloud sandbox providers.

## **How does DaisyRose-27B perform on benchmarks?**

All scores are self-reported by RadixArk. DaisyRose scores are the higher of its BF16 and FP8 runs.

| Benchmark | DaisyRose-27B | Qwen3.8-27B | Change | 
|---|---|---|---|
| Terminal Bench 4.1 (pass@1) | 12.0 | 5.6 | +6.4 | 
| Terminal Bench 2.1 | 75.5 | 73.0 | +2.5 | 
| DeepSWE v1.1 | 46.2 | 42.2 | +4.0 | 
| SWE Bench Pro v2 | 94.7 | 91.3 | +3.4 | 
| HLE (text only) | 34.3 | 33.9 | +0.4 | 
| IFBench | 82.4 | 79.5 | +2.9 | 
| GPQA Diamond | 90.7 | 89.2 | +1.5 | 

**Source:** RadixArk blog and model card.

The largest jump is Terminal Bench 4.1, which more than doubles. Coding gains are steady: +4.0 on DeepSWE v1.1 and +3.4 on SWE Bench Pro v2. Knowledge gains are small, at +0.4 on HLE and +1.5 on GPQA Diamond.

Against larger models, results are mixed. MiMo V2.6 Flash (309B total) leads Terminal Bench 4.1 at 16.1. Inkling 2 Small (594B total) leads DeepSWE at 72.1 and HLE at 44.1. DaisyRose-27B tops RadixArk’s 9-model table only on IFBench.

## **How do you deploy DaisyRose-27B?**

Weights are on Hugging Face in BF16, FP8, NVFP4 and GGUF. NVFP4 requires a Blackwell GPU. RadixArk recommends SGLang with DSpark speculative decoding. That setup uses the Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark draft model. vLLM also works via `vllm serve "RadixArk/DaisyRose-27B"`. Suggested thinking-mode sampling is temperature 1.0, top\_p 0.95 and top\_k 20.

## **How does DaisyRose-27B compare with similar-size models?**

| Metrics | DaisyRose-27B | Qwen3.8-27B | Muse Glimmer-30B | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | RadixArk | Qwen (Alibaba) | Meta Superintelligence Lab | Qwen (Alibaba) | 
| Total params | 27.8B | 27B | \~29.6B | 35B | 
| Active params | 27.8B (dense) | 27B (dense) | \~29.6B (dense) | 3B (MoE) | 
| Context | 262,144 | 262,144 (extensible to 1M) | 131,072+ | 262,144 (extensible to 1,010,000) | 
| License | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | 
| Input | Text, image | Text, image, video | Text, image | Text, image | 
| Hardware | 1 GPU; 52 GB BF16, 23 GB NVFP4 | Not disclosed | 64 GB full precision; under 20 GB 4-bit | Not disclosed | 
| Terminal Bench 2.1\* | 75.5 | 73.0 | 51.7 | 44.9 | 
| SWE Bench Pro v2\* | 94.7 | 91.3 | 80.4 | 73.3 | 
| DeepSWE v1.1\* | 46.2 | 42.2 | 4.4 | 0.0 | 
| HLE (text only)\* | 34.3 | 33.9 | 22.0 | 22.2 | 
| IFBench\* | 82.4 | 79.5 | 77.0 | 64.4 | 
| GPQA Diamond\* | 90.7 | 89.2 | 83.5 | 86.0 | 
| SWE-bench Pro (official card) | Not disclosed | 61.7 | 51.2 | 49.5 | 

*\*From RadixArk’s comparison table, which cites each developer’s reports or leaderboards. SWE Bench Pro v2 figures trace to arXiv 2611.16289. The last row comes from each model’s own card.*

## **Key Takeaways**

- RL only, no SFT: 1,200 tasks, 18 days, 144 H200s.
- Terminal Bench 4.1 jumps from 5.6 to 12.0.
- Fits 1 GPU: 52 GB in BF16, 23 GB in NVFP4.
- Miles hit 37% MFU, 2.0x faster end to end.
- Apache 2.0, but every score is self-reported.

Check out the **model card**, the **technical blog** and the **Miles repo**. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

content_zh:
本周 RadixArk 发布了 DaisyRose-27B，这是其首个开放权重模型。DaisyRose-27B 是 RadixArk 推出的智能体编程模型，基于 Qwen3.8-27B 通过强化学习（RL）进行后训练。模型卡页面指出，该模型仅使用 RL，未使用 SFT 或蒸馏。它以 Apache 2.0 许可发布，可作为基础模型的直接替代品。主要结果：Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 从 5.6 提升至 12.0。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**查看部署选项和规格。

## **要点速览**

- **规模：** 27.8B 稠密参数（0.46B 视觉编码器，0.42B MTP 头），262,144 token 上下文。
- **运行于：** 1 块 GPU。BF16 约 52 GB，FP8 约 29 GB，NVFP4 约 23 GB（仅 Blackwell）。列出的目标平台：H200、B200、GB300、RTX PRO 6000、RTX 5090、DGX Spark。也提供 GGUF。
- **性能：** 在所有 7 个报告的基准上均优于其 Qwen3.8-27B 基础模型。
- **最佳：** IFBench 82.4，在 RadixArk 对比的 9 个模型中得分最高。
- **最差：** HLE（纯文本）34.3，仅比基础模型高 +0.4，低于 Inkling 2 Small 的 44.1。
- **总结：** 最佳：经过 18 天 RL 后，Terminal Bench 4.1 提升超过一倍。最差：在困难的智能体任务上，它仍落后于大得多的 MoE 模型。

## **什么是 DaisyRose-27B？**

DaisyRose-27B 保持 Qwen3.8-27B 架构不变。模型卡列出 64 个解码器层，采用 3:1 模式。三个 Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力层与 1 个全注意力层交替。隐藏大小为 5,120。一个 27 层视觉编码器处理图像。一个多 token 预测层支持推测解码。输入为文本和图像，输出为文本，且它是一个思考模型。

## **DaisyRose-27B 是如何训练的？**

RadixArk 与 Eigent AI 一起构建了约 1,200 个精选任务，从数千个候选中选出。每个任务针对基础模型的一个特定失败。每个沙盒尝试允许最多 1.5 小时、100+ 次工具调用和 256k+ 输出 token。根据博客，智能体会话可达 1M token。

训练在 Miles 上运行，这是 RadixArk 的开源 RL 框架，采用全异步模式。该运行使用 144 块 H200 GPU，持续 18 天。其中，128 块处理智能体推理，16 块处理训练。总计算量为 63,000 GPU 小时。

RadixArk 报告其内部后端 MFU 为 37%。一个基于 Megatron 的开源训练器达到 16%。端到端吞吐量为 16.8k tokens/s 对 8.3k，加速 2.0 倍。RadixArk 表示这将 GPU 时间减少了 57%。

沙盒运行在 AgentENV 上。RadixArk 报告从 9 月中旬到 11 月中旬约有 944,000 个沙盒。峰值并发达到 1,566。9 周内创建成功率为 99%。RadixArk 估计成本比流行的云沙盒提供商低约 80%。

## **DaisyRose-27B 在基准测试上表现如何？**

所有分数均由 RadixArk 自行报告。DaisyRose 分数取其 BF16 和 FP8 运行中的较高值。

| 基准 | DaisyRose-27B | Qwen3.8-27B | 变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Terminal Bench 4.1 (pass@1) | 12.0 | 5.6 | +6.4 |
| Terminal Bench 2.1 | 75.5 | 73.0 | +2.5 |
| DeepSWE v1.1 | 46.2 | 42.2 | +4.0 |
| SWE Bench Pro v2 | 94.7 | 91.3 | +3.4 |
| HLE（纯文本） | 34.3 | 33.9 | +0.4 |
| IFBench | 82.4 | 79.5 | +2.9 |
| GPQA Diamond | 90.7 | 89.2 | +1.5 |

**来源：** RadixArk 博客与模型卡。

涨幅最大的是 Terminal Bench 4.1，提升超过一倍。编码能力稳步提升：DeepSWE v1.1 上 +4.0，SWE Bench Pro v2 上 +3.4。知识类提升较小，HLE 上 +0.4，GPQA Diamond 上 +1.5。

与更大模型相比，结果参差不齐。MiMo V2.6 Flash（总参数 309B）以 16.1 领跑 Terminal Bench 4.1。Inkling 2 Small（总参数 594B）以 72.1 领跑 DeepSWE、以 44.1 领跑 HLE。DaisyRose-27B 在 RadixArk 的 9 模型表格中仅在 IFBench 上位居第一。

## **如何部署 DaisyRose-27B？**

权重已在 Hugging Face 上发布，提供 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 和 GGUF 格式。NVFP4 需要 Blackwell GPU。RadixArk 推荐使用 SGLang 并配合 DSpark 投机解码。该方案使用 Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark 草稿模型。vLLM 也可通过 `vllm serve "RadixArk/DaisyRose-27B"` 使用。建议的思考模式采样参数为 temperature 1.0、top\_p 0.95 和 top\_k 20。

## **DaisyRose-27B 与同尺寸模型相比如何？**

| 指标 | DaisyRose-27B | Qwen3.8-27B | Muse Glimmer-30B | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 开发者 | RadixArk | Qwen (Alibaba) | Meta Superintelligence Lab | Qwen (Alibaba) | 
| 总参数 | 27.8B | 27B | \~29.6B | 35B | 
| 激活参数 | 27.8B（稠密） | 27B（稠密） | \~29.6B（稠密） | 3B（MoE） | 
| 上下文 | 262,144 | 262,144（可扩展至 1M） | 131,072+ | 262,144（可扩展至 1,010,000） | 
| 许可证 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Apache 2.0 | 
| 输入 | 文本、图像 | 文本、图像、视频 | 文本、图像 | 文本、图像 | 
| 硬件 | 1 块 GPU；BF16 下 52 GB，NVFP4 下 23 GB | 未披露 | 全精度 64 GB；4-bit 下低于 20 GB | 未披露 | 
| Terminal Bench 2.1\* | 75.5 | 73.0 | 51.7 | 44.9 | 
| SWE Bench Pro v2\* | 94.7 | 91.3 | 80.4 | 73.3 | 
| DeepSWE v1.1\* | 46.2 | 42.2 | 4.4 | 0.0 | 
| HLE（仅文本）\* | 34.3 | 33.9 | 22.0 | 22.2 | 
| IFBench\* | 82.4 | 79.5 | 77.0 | 64.4 | 
| GPQA Diamond\* | 90.7 | 89.2 | 83.5 | 86.0 | 
| SWE-bench Pro（官方模型卡） | 未披露 | 61.7 | 51.2 | 49.5 | 

*\*来自 RadixArk 的对比表，该表引用了各开发者的报告或排行榜。SWE Bench Pro v2 数据可追溯至 arXiv 2611.16289。最后一行来自各模型自己的模型卡。*

## **要点速览**

- 仅用 RL，无 SFT：1,200 个任务，18 天，144 块 H200。
- Terminal Bench 4.1 从 5.6 跃升至 12.0。
- 适配 1 块 GPU：BF16 下 52 GB，NVFP4 下 23 GB。
- Miles 达到 37% MFU，端到端提速 2.0 倍。
- Apache 2.0，但所有分数均为自报。

查看**模型卡**、**技术博客**和 **Miles 仓库**。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**在此查看部署选项和规格。
